From: Priya Nandakumar
To: Permit Desk, Building Services
Date: 2026-05-04
Subject: Deck permit BP-26-0817 still "In review"

Hello,
I submitted my application for a rear deck (BP-26-0817) on April 6. Your website says standard residential permits are reviewed within 20 business days, but the portal still shows "In review". My contractor is booked to start on May 18. If we can't start then, he can't come back until August and I lose my $1,200 deposit. Can you tell me what is happening?
Priya

From: Gary Lindqvist, Permit Clerk
Date: 2026-05-04
Subject: RE: Deck permit BP-26-0817 still "In review"

Hi Priya,
I've looked at the file. The application was missing a site plan showing the deck's distance to the property lines. We emailed a notice on April 9, but the address on the form has a typo, so it bounced. Under our rules the review clock stops until the site plan is received, and nothing has been reviewed yet. Once we receive it, reviews like this are typically finished within 7 business days. Payment of the $180 permit fee is due at issue.
Gary
